_note: Routing policy: the INTENTS an agent/task declares instead of a hard-coded model. Each intent is a hard-constraint problem — filter models by the ceilings/floor + provider allowlist, then optimize the objective. This is the ONE file you tune to change the cost/latency/accuracy posture of the whole crew. Posture: TIER by leverage (Fable 5 for the one genuinely-hard problem; Opus for accuracy-critical strategy; Sonnet 5 as the workhorse for code + advice; Haiku/Gemini-Flash-Lite for volume) and deliberately go CROSS-VENDOR for the roles whose job is to independently check Claude-authored work (review -> OpenAI GPT, red-team -> Google Gemini), so their blind spots differ from the author's AND from each other. Provider allowlists encode that vendor diversity on purpose. Cost caps below are per-task USD at ~20k in + 6k out. Override at ~/.pi-stack/routing/policy.json.

intents.name: max-accuracy
intents.about: One genuinely hard problem, no cost ceiling: the 'even Opus falls short' tier. -> the strongest model overall (Fable 5).

intents.name: strategy
intents.about: Accuracy-critical judgment/synthesis where a wrong call is expensive and hard to detect: architecture, product strategy. Best Anthropic reasoner under an Opus-tier cap (excludes the Fable frontier). -> Opus.

intents.name: code
intents.about: Production code/design on the primary production vendor, best value under a per-task cap. -> Sonnet 5 (Anthropic's own recommendation for most coding).

intents.name: advisory
intents.about: The specialist advisor crew (finance, legal, sre, dx, devrel, growth, ux, enterprise-admin, enrich): strong, cost-effective reasoning + writing. -> the Sonnet 5 workhorse.

intents.name: reasoning
intents.about: General-purpose reasoning for ad-hoc `--intent reasoning` use (no vendor lock). Best accuracy under a mid-tier cost cap across all vendors.

intents.name: review
intents.about: Adversarial second opinion on Claude-authored work. Allowlist EXCLUDES Anthropic (and Google, reserved for red-team) so review is a distinct vendor from both author and red-team. -> GPT-5.6 Sol.

intents.name: red-team
intents.about: A SECOND, independent cross-vendor voice for adversarial scrutiny (e.g. security review). Pinned to a THIRD vendor so it is independent of both the author (Claude) and the reviewer (GPT). -> Gemini 3.1 Pro (reasoning/GPQA leader).

intents.name: authoring
intents.about: Powers the agentic `agent new` flow that drafts prompts + writes eval cases. Needs strong judgment + valid structured output. -> Opus (best Anthropic reasoner under an Opus-tier cap).

intents.name: breadth
intents.about: Cheap, fast parallel fan-out. Cheapest model clearing an accuracy floor + latency ceiling. -> Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite (the volume floor).

intents.name: verify
intents.about: Test/QA passes: best accuracy within the cheap tier (tight cost cap). -> Haiku 4.5.
